s1.syndrome_frame: Bilateral ocular inflammation with recent onset of blurred vision and ocular irritation, following a systemic illness with fever and arthralgia
salient_findings: Stromal immune ring formation with underlying keratic precipitates
Positive PCR results for Chikungunya virus in aqueous tap
key_facts: Patient is a teenage girl from Saint-Martin
Presented with bilateral blurred vision and ocular irritation
Experienced fever and severe arthralgia one month earlier
Neurological complications are present
Periorbital hyperpigmentation is present
Ocular history is negative for trauma and previous inflammation
Primary HIV infection, tuberculosis, sarcoidosis, and syphilis have been ruled out
Best-corrected visual acuity is 20/20 OU
Slitlamp biomicroscopy revealed bilateral punctate superficial keratitis and stromal immune ring formation
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography confirmed localized anterior stromal infiltrate
Aqueous tap PCR results are positive for Chikungunya virus
IgM CHIKV serologic test is positive

shortlist.label: Chikungunya virus ocular infection
shortlist.why_kept: Positive aqueous tap PCR results and positive IgM CHIKV serologic test

shortlist.label: Herpes simplex keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral punctate superficial keratitis and stromal immune ring formation

shortlist.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic ocular inflammation with stromal immune ring formation

shortlist.label: Acute retinal necrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral ocular inflammation and recent onset of blurred vision

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of bilateral blurred vision, ocular irritation, and recent history of fever and arthralgia, combined with the positive aqueous tap PCR results for Chikungunya virus and positive IgM CHIKV serologic test, strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Herpes simplex keratitis
rejected.why: Aqueous tap PCR results were negative for human herpesviruses 1 and 2

rejected.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and laboratory results do not match the typical characteristics of this condition

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: There is no mention of retinochoroiditis or other typical features of toxoplasmosis in the patient's presentation

rejected.label: Acute retinal necrosis
rejected.why: The patient's fundus examination was normal, and there is no mention of retinal necrosis or other characteristic features of this condition
